name: Tidewick next-chapter note
description: One short note when the next chapter is waiting. Off unless the player switches it on.
schedule: Weekly on Saturday at 10:00 in the owner's timezone, or the day and time the player picks when switching it on.
quiet_when: Not switched on by the player; reminder set to off in the casebook; every chapter finished; a chapter played or started in the last 6 days; or a note was already sent for this chapter and it hasn't been played since.
job: Read the casebook first. If none of the quiet rules apply, send one line: "Chapter {N}, '{title}', is ready when you are. Say 'play' to start, or 'stop reminders'." At most one message, never a chaser, no guilt or streak talk. Then run casebook.py note-sent so no second note goes out for this chapter.
